logicalQuery: SELECT meter_id, recorded_at, energy_kwh, is_estimated FROM readings WHERE energy_kwh >= ? AND quality_flag = ? ORDER BY meter_id, recorded_at
postgresQuery: SELECT meter_id, recorded_at, energy_kwh, is_estimated FROM readings WHERE energy_kwh >= $1 AND quality_flag = $2 ORDER BY meter_id, recorded_at

crossEngine.note: DuckDB and PostgreSQL run the same logical query over the same fixture; normalised columns, rows and resultDigest are equal (tests/integration/x03-cross-engine-equivalence.spec.ts). The only difference between the two queries is the dialect placeholder syntax ('?' vs '$n'), which is confined to the adapter-side query text.
